fusions.name: Annotated Edge
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A spell-edged strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Blight] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% per affliction the target carries (max +50%), and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fair Copy
fusions.desc: Hurls a scribed bolt that deals 28 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Practiced Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 12 seconds. You restore 10 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Margin Notes
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
